title: Bitwise Operators
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of bitwise operators and identify when it is appropriate in a Java program.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study bitwise operators with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you predict calculations accurately and make conversion or precision trade-offs visible. In this lesson, focus on and, or, xor, and complement and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.
